objective: A2-c runtime smoke: prove Archon loads and executes a bash-only IR-compiled DAG (no provider header), that the run message reaches bash nodes as $ARGUMENTS, and that artifacts land under artifacts/runs/<uuid>.

inputs.note: no inputs — the run message itself is the probe payload

acceptance: bash-only DAG loads and completes without any provider/model lane
$ARGUMENTS carries the run message verbatim into the bash node

nodes.ref: printf '{"received": "%s"}' "${ARGUMENTS:-none}" > smoke-arguments.json && printf 'a2c runtime smoke ok\n' > smoke-artifact.txt
